key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological damages
evidence_snippets: 1995-01-17, 5:46: a Magnitude 7.9 earthquake shook Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo Prefecture.
It took more than 6,400 lives, destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
Last year's Niigata Earthquake, magnitude 6.8... the human toll—35 lives lost—was far less severe.
While damages to buildings in Niigita were high.
